title: Enable OpenClaw coding tools and verify executor
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$cfg=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json';$j=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($null -eq $j.tools){$j|Add-Member -NotePropertyName tools -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{})};if($j.tools.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'profile'){$j.tools.profile='coding'}else{$j.tools|Add-Member -NotePropertyName profile -NotePropertyValue 'coding'};$tmp=$cfg+'.tmp';$j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50|Set-Content $tmp -Encoding UTF8;$null=Get-Content $tmp -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;Move-Item $tmp $cfg -Force;& openclaw.cmd gateway restart 2>&1|Out-Null;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED'};$ok=$false;for($i=0;$i -lt 15;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$g=& openclaw.cmd gateway status --json 2>&1;if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){try{$gj=$g|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json;if($gj.service.runtime.status -eq 'running'){$ok=$true;break}}catch{}}};if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_NOT_RUNNING_AFTER_RESTART'};$target='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge/061a-openclaw-created.txt';Remove-Item $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$msg='Use an available filesystem or shell tool to create the file C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge/061a-openclaw-created.txt containing exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK. You must actually use a tool and create the file. Then reply exactly OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK.';$so=Join-Path $root '061a-agent.json';$se=Join-Path $root '061a-agent.err.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$out=& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key '3en-061a' --message $msg --json --timeout 180 2>$se;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$txt=$out|Out-String;$txt|Set-Content $so -Encoding UTF8;if($ec -ne 0){$err=if(Test-Path $se){Get-Content $se -Raw}else{''};throw ('AGENT_FAILED code='+$ec+' stderr='+$err)};$null=$txt|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not(Test-Path $target)){throw 'OPENCLAW_FILE_NOT_CREATED'};if((Get-Content $target -Raw).Trim() -ne 'OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK'){throw 'OPENCLAW_FILE_CONTENT_INVALID'};Write-Output 'OPENCLAW_EXECUTOR_OK';Write-Output 'V423_061A_EXECUTOR=PASS'
